title: G-FurniMatic
description:
Feeds the Furni-Matic for you: pick the furni you want to get rid of and it recycles them 8 at a time.

- Waits for the hotel's answer and its pause between batches, batch after batch or one at a time
- Keep a few of each, lock furni that must never go; LTDs and rentals stay out
- Safe price: furni worth more on the Marketplace are hidden and need your OK
- Places, opens and picks up prize boxes in your own room, and logs every prize with its rarity
- No game sounds or popups for things you didn't do

English, Español, Português.
